title: Single Number
description: Every value in the array appears exactly twice except for one value. Return the value that appears only once. Solve the problem using constant extra space.
inputFormat: First line: integer n, the number of elements
outputFormat: Print the integer that appears only once.
constraints: Every element appears twice except for one element

examples.explanation: The value 1 is the only value that occurs once.
The values 1 and 2 occur twice, leaving 4 as the single number.

title: Number of 1 Bits
description: Given a non-negative integer n, return the number of set bits in its binary representation.
outputFormat: Print the number of set bits.

examples.explanation: The binary representation 1011 contains three set bits.

title: Counting Bits
description: Given n, return an array where answer[i] is the number of set bits in i for every integer from 0 through n.

examples.explanation: These are the set-bit counts for the integers 0 through 5.

title: Reverse Bits
description: Reverse all 32 bits of an unsigned integer and return the resulting unsigned integer.
outputFormat: Print the integer represented by the reversed bits.

examples.explanation: Reversing the 32-bit representation produces the output value.

title: Missing Number
description: An array contains n distinct values selected from the range 0 through n. Return the one value missing from the range.

examples.explanation: The value 2 is absent from the range 0 through 3.

title: Power of Two
description: Return true when the given integer is an exact power of two; otherwise return false.

examples.explanation: 16 equals 2 raised to the fourth power.

title: Minimum Bit Flips to Convert Number
description: Given integers start and goal, return the minimum number of individual bit flips needed to convert start into goal.
inputFormat: Two space-separated integers start and goal
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of bit flips.

examples.explanation: The values differ at three bit positions.

title: Single Number II
description: Every array value appears three times except one value that appears once. Return the unique value using constant extra space.
outputFormat: Print the value that occurs once.
constraints: Each repeated value occurs exactly three times

examples.explanation: The value 2 occurs three times and 3 occurs once.

title: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range
description: Given left and right, return the bitwise AND of every integer in the inclusive range.
inputFormat: Two space-separated integers left and right

title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers
description: Given an integer array, return the maximum XOR obtainable from any pair of array values.

examples.explanation: The pair 5 and 25 produces the maximum XOR value 28.
